sections.title: Dental Auxiliary Utilization IA
sections.description: Module 1 will provide a series of lectures focused on the basic principles of radiology including radiobiology, radiation medicine and technique. A hands-on component will provide the student with experience in taking radiographs. Module 2 will teach the student four-handed dental assisting technique and improve skills such as patient communication, team building, and record keeping.
